title: Flow notify step records success when its only channel was refused and nothing was delivered
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect (a run record reports success for a delivery that did not happen, reproduced through the API).

QA-source: #32135 · integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery · clause 4 (observed beside it)

## What happens

A flow `notify` step whose only channel is refused (here `push`, not registered on the deployment) records the step as `success` with `selected: 1, acted: 0`. The only signal is a server WARN line ("channel 'push' is not registered; refused 1 delivery row(s)").

## Reproduction (framework ff04ad81, stock showcase)

1. Author a flow whose `notify` node names only the `push` channel; trigger it.
2. Read the run's step records through the automation runs API: the notify step reads `status: 'success'`.
3. No inbox row exists; the server log carries the WARN above.

- Expected: a step that delivered nothing says so in the run record (failed, or a warning/skipped status naming the refused channel), so the run history tells an admin why nobody was notified.
- Actual: `success`.

## Reach

Every flow run history in the console and over the API.

## Why it matters

An admin debugging "nobody got notified" reads a green run; the cause is only in server logs they may not have.

## Reader

Triage first touch; the fix lands in `packages/services/service-automation` (the notify executor's step outcome) with `service-messaging` supplying the refused count.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack notify channel refused step success` (74, open and closed): no card for the step outcome.
